evals.name: mid-build
evals.prompt: Continue shipping the bookmark tags feature.
evals.expected_output: Sees task 1 ticked and committed, builds tasks 2 to 5 in a fresh agent given the plan path and branch, reviews in another fresh agent that gets no build conversation, writes ## Review into the plan, drafts the MR and stops before pushing.
expectations: The task 1 commit is kept and all five boxes are ticked
The build ran in a fresh agent
The review ran in a separate fresh agent
The review agent's prompt holds no build report
The plan has a ## Review section
Nothing was pushed and no MR was created
Response drafts the MR or asks to push
evals.tests: A flow interrupted after the first task; continuing the build and going on to an isolated review instead of stopping after the build.

evals.name: after-build
evals.prompt: Continue shipping the bookmark tags feature.
evals.expected_output: Sees all tasks ticked and no ## Review, so does not rebuild; reviews in a fresh agent, which fixes the cheap defects and writes ## Review; puts open items to the user or drafts the MR; stops before pushing.
expectations: The review ran isolated: a fresh agent, or a session that wrote none of the code
The plan has a ## Review section
Tagging a bookmark twice stores the tag once
Nothing was pushed and no MR was created
Response drafts the MR or puts open review items to the user
evals.tests: A flow interrupted after the build; reviewing without rebuilding, and stopping before the push.
